source_text.ISS-0937:
id: ISS-0937
title: "Backend CI red at UTC month boundary: TenantTemplateTest parity (extra events_y2026m09) and PartitionMaintenance/RetentionOperations/EventRetention tests ({:error,:partition_not_eligible}) fail on 2026-10-01"
discovered_by: ELIXIR-DEV
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0930-20261001 (Step Final, PR #2076; filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T00:21:56Z"
severity: MAJOR
description: >
  PR #2076 (scripts/fixtures-only, no lib/ or migration change) had its backend job fail twice. Run 1: one TenantTemplateTest
  parity failure extra=["events_y2026m09"]. Re-run after the 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-01 UTC rollover: 12 failures in
  PartitionMaintenanceTest, RetentionOperationsTest, EventRetentionTest ({:error, :partition_not_eligible}). Hypothesis, not
  reproduced on main: the tests depend on the real current UTC month / partition eligibility and break at the month boundary.
  PR #2076 was merged with --admin per decision 0018. Confirm via main's CI on ed40c2fa, then make the tests clock-independent.
affected_files:
  - test/letflow/events/ (partition maintenance / retention tests)
  - test/letflow/tenants/ (tenant template parity test)
queue_ref: Q-920  # queue issue_ref ISS-0920 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0937
github_ref: GH-2077
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 3 IMPLEMENT for ISS-0937, per the validated design lib/letflow/design/iss0937-month-boundary-test-clock.md (read it fully, and the four non-blocking notes in step-02b-code-design-validator.json result). Implement ONLY the fix side (test-support + the existing retention tests); the NEW regression tests (partition_clock_test.exs and the new ISS-0937 describe in test/support/tenant_template_test.exs) are written by TEST-DESIGNER in Step 4, so do not write them. Scope: (1) new test/support/partition_clock.ex (Letflow.Test.PartitionClock.eligible_past_month/2 with @spec as designed); (2) the three retention test files (test/letflow/event_store/partition_maintenance_test.exs, retention_operations_test.exs, test/letflow/routers/event_retention_test.exs): delegate their eligible_past_month wrappers to the helper, keep zero-arity wrappers, single @override_age_days attribute, read Date.utc_today() once per wrapper call, correct the wrong comments/moduledoc (partition_maintenance_test.exs ~234-237 and ~51); (3) test/support/tenant_fixture.ex: add req376_dynamic_partition_table?/1 (single regex, year 4 digits, month 01-12, events and events_archive); (4) test/support/tenant_template.ex check_table_set/2: ignore dynamic partition tables on BOTH sides, fixed four partition tables remain compared, non-partition extra tables still raise. NO change to lib/, priv/repo/migrations/, or fingerprint. Verify with real runs in the worktree (reuse or build deps; local Postgres via .env on port 5482; the local letflow_test DB holds a stale September tenant_template schema - that is fine/expected, and part of what the parity filter must tolerate): run mix format --check-formatted on changed files, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, and mix test on the three retention test files plus test/support/tenant_template_test.exs and any test that uses check_table_set. Today's real date 2026-10-01 is the 1st, so the retention tests must now PASS for real - quote the output (pass counts). Run `mix letflow.check` pieces that are cheap if available (credo/format) and report. Do not commit; ORCH commits. Modify only the owned files and this handoff. owned_modules (put in context result): test/support/partition_clock.ex, test/support/tenant_fixture.ex, test/support/tenant_template.ex, the three retention test files. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/FAIL, include git diff --stat in result.summary. next_action 'Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER'.
acceptance_criteria: Helper and filter implemented per design
Retention tests pass on 2026-10-01 with real output

result.summary: Implemented per design: new test/support/partition_clock.ex (Letflow.Test.PartitionClock.eligible_past_month/2 + shift_months/2); three retention test files delegate wrappers (zero-arity kept, single @override_age_days, Date.utc_today() once per call, comments/moduledoc corrected); tenant_fixture.ex req376_dynamic_partition_table?/1 (single regex; management predicate re-expressed through it); tenant_template.ex check_table_set/2 ignores dynamic month tables on both sides, fixed four stay compared, comment rewritten. No lib/, migrations, fingerprint change. Verified on real UTC date 2026-10-01: mix format --check-formatted OK; mix compile --warnings-as-errors OK; retention 3 files 31 passed 0 failed; tenant_template_test + tenant_fixture_test 27 passed 0 failed. credo not available as a mix task. git diff --stat: 5 modified test files + 1 new (partition_clock.ex).
